verdict.rationale: A business registry could plausibly offer event-driven automation such as filing-change triggers or alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a generic 'Email notifications' link and email update subscriptions, with no user-defined rules or automatic actions on events. The keyless open-data API is a developer building block served from the Socrata platform, not a rules engine, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
